question: What is the inference throughput of MiniLM on this laptop?
rationale: Adversarial. The report names MiniLM and a student laptop, so most content words ARE present; only 'throughput' is absent. A gate keyed on rare-word absence can miss this. Included so the measured rate reflects the real difficulty rather than only easy negatives.
